spans.s: पैशाच (II) m. 1. The last of the eight forms of marriage in Hindu law; in it, the lover defiles a damsel without her consent when she is sleeping or intoxicated or deranged in intellect (सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा रहो यत्रोपगच्छति । स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां पैशाचः प्रथितोऽधमः M.iii.34), Yaj.i.61; 2. a kind of demon.
पैशाची f. 1. The lowest Prākṛt dialect spoken on the stage by demons; 2. a present made at a religious ceremony; 3. night.
पैशुन n. 1. Backbiting, tale-bearing, Bg.xvi.2, M.vii.48; 2. malignity, roguery.
